<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>4-bit unsigned number pipeline multiplier with two levels of registers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for chip reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit input signal representing the multiplicand.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit input signal representing the multiplier.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit product output signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="size">4</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="partial_products" width="8" depth="4">Stores partial products.</register>
        <register id="sum_reg" width="8">Stores intermediate sum values.</register>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Extend input signals by adding 'size' number of zero bits at the most significant bit positions
        reg [7:0] mul_a_extended;
        reg [7:0] mul_b_extended;
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                mul_a_extended <= 8'b0;
                mul_b_extended <= 8'b0;
            end else begin
                mul_a_extended <= {mul_a, 4'b0};
                mul_b_extended <= {mul_b, 4'b0};
            end
        end

        // Generate partial products
        genvar i;
        generate
            for (i = 0; i < size; i = i + 1) begin : partial_product_gen
                always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
                    if (!rst_n) begin
                        partial_products[i] <= 8'b0;
                    end else begin
                        if (mul_b_extended[i]) begin
                            partial_products[i] <= mul_a_extended << i;
                        end else begin
                            partial_products[i] <= 8'b0;
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        endgenerate

        // Add partial products
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                sum_reg <= 8'b0;
            end else begin
                sum_reg <= partial_products[0];
                for (i = 1; i < size; i = i + 1) begin
                    sum_reg <= sum_reg + partial_products[i];
                end
            end
        end

        // Final product calculation
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                mul_out <= 8'b0;
            end else begin
                mul_out <= sum_reg;
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
